# Northern Midwest Regional Council of Carpenters

> > The Northern Midwest Regional Council of Carpenters represents United Brotherhood of Carpenters (UBC) members across Minnesota, Wisconsin, Iowa, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Nebraska, providing union representation, apprenticeship training, and advocacy for construction workers.

The NMCARPENTERS organization connects dozens of local carpenter and millwright unions across the upper Midwest, offering wage standards, benefits information, leadership training, and community support. The site serves as a hub for local union information, member resources, training programs, and news affecting construction workers in the region.

## Key Topics

- United Brotherhood of Carpenters (UBC)
- Union locals and local officers
- Apprenticeship and training programs
- Minnesota, Wisconsin, Iowa, North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska
- Meeting schedules and union meetings
- Wage standards and benefits
- Community support and PPE donations
- Leadership development
- Millwrights
- Career Connections pre-apprenticeship
- North Central States Regional Council of Carpenters (NCSRCC)
- COVID-19 response and healthcare support
- Worker rights and back wages
- Twin Cities area construction

## Union Locals

- [Twin Cities Area](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/twin-cities-area): Twin Cities carpenter wages, UBC benefits, apprenticeship & training info
- [Carpenters Local 202](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/local/carpenters-local-202): Local 202 Grayling, MI: officers, meeting schedule, contact info
- [Carpenters Local 731](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/local/carpenters-local-731): Local 731 Sheboygan, WI: officers, meetings, union information
- [Carpenters and Millwrights Local 1176](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/local/carpenters-and-millwrights-local-1176): Local 1176 Fargo, ND: officers, meeting schedule, millwrights union info
- [Industrial Local 2055](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/local/industrial-local-2055): Industrial Local 2055 St. Paul: officers, meeting schedule, contact info

## Training and Development

- [UBC Leadership Training](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/training/ubc-leadership-training): UBC journey-level leadership training programs for jobsite development
- [Carpenter Skill Sheet](http://www.nmcarpenters.com/carpenter-skill-sheet): UBC carpenter skill registration form for certifications & experience
